coreSkillDepth.instructions: Judge the candidate's depth in the role's must-have skills, based on what the projects demonstrate rather than what the candidate claims.
criteria: No evidence of the required skills
Skills listed but not demonstrated in any project
Led or architected production work using these skills

seniorityFit.instructions: Relative to the role's stated seniority, where does this candidate sit?

criteria.over: Significantly above; may not accept this role

hasShippedProduction.instructions: Does the portfolio show work that ran in production with real users outside the candidate's own team?
